values.note: 20 RV pull-through sites with water and electric (20/30/50 amp) and 10 no-power tent sites along the shore.
Reservations by e-mail, with a two-night deposit for weekends and holidays; not always needed. Cash or check only.
Rates include sales tax: a 30-amp RV site (rigs 20 ft and over) is $35 and a 50-amp site $40 a day for 2 people; $8 per extra person 6 and older. A $10 charge per dump.

note: Fishing campground at the Eureka lock and dam on the Upper Fox River, 18 miles west of Oshkosh. The RV pull-throughs sit on a tree-ringed loop between the river and the old lock canal, with the river through the trees; the no-power sites along the shore are for tents. Boat rental and launch, bank fishing; no swimming. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront -> riverview PROPOSED. The Fox River here is ~90 m wide (river class). The operator's map puts the 20 RV pull-through sites INSIDE a loop road ringed by a tree line, with the canal on one side and the river on the other; the shoreline sites are 'Primitive Sites (No Power)' 1-10 that the fee page prices as 'Tents along shore'. On Esri imagery the river-side lane of the loop (about 43.9970,-88.8708 to 43.9976,-88.8702) sits ~20-35 m from the bank behind a continuous fringe of trees and brush; the gallery's 'camping on the river' photo shows no water from the RV rows. No RV site is shown within ~50 m over open ground, so the value goes down to a view (river visible through the thin tree line).

PRICE GATE (private): PASSES - cheapest real RV night is $35 for a 30-amp site, rigs 20 ft and over, sales tax included; summer peak the same ($35 / $40 50-amp; no seasonal pricing posted). The $31 20-amp rate is for rigs up to 20 ft only.
LONG-STAY: posts only daily fees, no seasonal/monthly rate, 'Day Visitors, overnight or destination campers welcome' - nightly share effectively all 30 sites; not a long-stay park.
PAYMENT: 'Cash or check only. We do not accept credit or debt cards' - kept in booking.note.
PHONE 920-685-5441 and website https://eurekadam.weebly.com/ confirmed - no change.
